subject: AcreetionOS Update — July 09, 2026
body:
Our continuous integration pipeline has just become even more robust with the latest enhancements, including per-pipeline staging directories and relative symlinks for the latest.iso file, which significantly improve the reliability of our ISO build process. This is a direct result of our community's tireless efforts to refine and stabilize our workflow, ensuring that AcreetionOS remains a cutting-edge, Arch-based Linux distribution.

Development 
The recent updates to our CI pipeline are a testament to our community's dedication to delivering a seamless experience for users. By avoiding publish races between concurrent builds, we can ensure that our ISOs are always up-to-date and ready for download from https://acreetionos.org/. Our team is committed to maintaining the highest standards of quality and stability, and these enhancements are a significant step forward in achieving that goal.

Community 
The release of Emacs 31.1 has generated a lot of excitement within our community, with many users exploring its new features and improvements. Our wiki page at https://acreetionos.org/wiki.html is being constantly updated with the latest information and guides, including details on how to get the most out of Emacs 31.1. We also encourage users to check out our changelog at https://acreetionos.org/changelog.html to stay up-to-date with the latest developments and security updates, such as those issued on Monday.

Tip of the day 
For users looking to get started with AcreetionOS, our documentation at https://acreetionos.org/docs.html provides a comprehensive guide to installing and configuring the distribution. We also recommend checking out our flash page at https://acreetionos.org/flash.html for the latest news and updates on the project. With its immutable-style workflow and emphasis on simplicity, AcreetionOS is an ideal choice for users who value stability and ease of use.
